'''Nick Heinbach''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Seattle tournament (16 September)]] on 16 September 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court-flip]], according to Keith Watabayashi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1233">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-seattle-wa-9-16-00d1233/ seattle-wa-9-16-00], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 16 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-seattle-wa-9-16-00d1233/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
